blocks.name: Toolbar with Button Actions
blocks.description: Toolbar component with a title and action buttons in the end slot, featuring a text button, tonal button, and raised primary button for common form or dialog actions

blocks.name: Simple Toolbar
blocks.description: Horizontal toolbar component featuring a centered title section with icon action buttons positioned at the end for common operations such as search, filter, and overflow menu actions

blocks.name: Table Header
blocks.description: Toolbar component designed for table headers, featuring a title in the start slot and action icon buttons for filtering, exporting, and additional options in the end slot

blocks.name: Page Title with Back Arrow
blocks.description: Toolbar with back navigation button, page title heading, and action icon buttons for notifications, settings, and more options

blocks.name: Page Title
blocks.description: Toolbar with page title heading and action icon buttons for notifications, settings, and more options

blocks.name: Table with Detail Sidesheet
blocks.description: Application layout with a data table where the last column contains an icon button that opens a right-side drawer sidesheet to display row details alongside the table

blocks.name: Table with Icon Actions
blocks.description: Data table inside a card with a toolbar header featuring icon buttons for filtering, exporting, and additional options

blocks.name: Table with Actions
blocks.description: Data table inside a card with a toolbar header featuring action buttons for cancel, save draft, and submit operations

blocks.name: Simple Table
blocks.description: Data table component wrapped in a card container with a toolbar header, demonstrating column configuration and data binding for displaying tabular information with multiple columns and rows

blocks.name: Paginated Table
blocks.description: Data table with client-side pagination inside a structured card, featuring header action buttons for filtering, exporting, and additional options, along with a paginator control for navigating through large datasets by page

blocks.name: Simple Scaffold Card
blocks.description: Card component using forge-scaffold for structured layout with toolbar header, scrollable body, and inverted toolbar footer with action buttons

blocks.name: Sidesheet Scaffold Card
blocks.description: Card component using forge-scaffold with a drawer in the body-left slot, demonstrating a card with an integrated side panel

blocks.name: Filter Facets
blocks.description: Filter facets rendered inside a drawer with scaffold layout, demonstrating checkboxes for multi-select and radio buttons for single-select filtering. Uses partials for reusable facet patterns. Use as a reference for building filter sidesheets, filter panels within cards, data table filters, and other page filtering UI.

blocks.name: List Management
blocks.description: Card with a text field and add button for managing a dynamic list of items, supporting keyboard entry and item deletion

blocks.name: Simple Dialog
blocks.description: Modal dialog with scaffold layout featuring a toolbar header with title and close button, scrollable body content area, and footer toolbar with secondary cancel and primary confirm action buttons

blocks.name: Login Form
blocks.description: Centered authentication form card displayed over a gradient background, featuring credential input fields with labels, a remember-me checkbox, a forgot password link, a primary submit button, a visual divider, and a secondary registration link

blocks.name: Complex Form with Grouped Sections
blocks.description: Responsive form divided into logically grouped sections (project details, timeline, team, location, settings, notifications) using a 6-column grid system that adapts to mobile, featuring various column spans for flexible one, two, and three column field arrangements that stack on smaller screens

blocks.name: Add User Form
blocks.description: Form card with two-column grid layout for text inputs, leading icons, support text, dropdown selects, grouped checkboxes, and action buttons

blocks.name: Add Illustration Form
blocks.description: Centered card form displayed over a decorative background with abstract SVG elements, featuring a header with icon and title, text input fields, a textarea for longer descriptions, a chip field for adding searchable tags, and a file picker component for uploading files

blocks.name: Horizontal Label Value List
blocks.description: Read-only data display arranged as a two-column grid with labels on the left and values on the right. Labels use the forge-label-value label styling (label2 typography, medium color) while values use body1 typography. Rows wrap independently, so long labels and multi-line values keep their column alignment. Includes an example of an empty value rendered as an italic "n/a" placeholder. Useful for detail summaries, definition lists, entity metadata panels, and read-only field displays.

blocks.name: Tabbed Card
blocks.description: Card with tab navigation that switches between different content views using forge-tab-bar and forge-view-switcher

blocks.name: Responsive Cards
blocks.description: Auto-fitting responsive grid of content cards that adapts to available space, with each card featuring a header image, category badge, title, description text, an action link with icon, and engagement metrics displaying view and comment counts

blocks.name: Icon Card
blocks.description: Action card featuring an icon, title, and description for quick navigation or feature highlights

blocks.name: Cohort Status Card
blocks.description: Responsive card with a summary section (title and subtitle) on the left and a multi-column status grid on the right showing progress through sequential phases or milestones with completion indicators and dates. Grid collapses to stacked layout on smaller screens. Useful for release rollouts, deployment phases, onboarding steps, approval workflows, or any multi-stage process tracker.

blocks.name: Basic Card
blocks.description: Structured card with header, header actions, body content area, and footer with action buttons

blocks.name: Three Panel Layout
blocks.description: Application layout demonstrating content in the left navigation drawer, main body area, and right drawer panel. Uses gray striped boxes as placeholder content. Reference this block for building layouts with sidebars, detail panels, or supplementary content areas.

blocks.name: Table with Filter Sidesheet
blocks.description: Full application layout with header, left navigation drawer, paginated data table in the body, and a filter sidesheet in the right drawer. Demonstrates a common pattern for data-heavy applications with filtering capabilities.

blocks.name: Mini Nav Application Layout
blocks.description: Application shell with a collapsible mini navigation drawer that expands on hover, an app bar with notification icons and a user profile dropdown with theme toggle

blocks.name: Dual Scrolling Containers
blocks.description: Application layout demonstrating dual independent scrolling regions where the main content area and a fixed right-side drawer panel each scroll independently, useful for master-detail views or side-by-side content comparison layouts

blocks.name: Detailed Context Switcher
blocks.description: Application layout with a detailed context switcher in the navigation drawer. The selected context (organization, property, account, workspace, etc.) determines the scope of all data displayed throughout the app. Features a prominent current context display with name, address, quick actions, and a dropdown to switch contexts.

blocks.name: Compact Context Switcher
blocks.description: Application layout with a compact context switcher in the navigation drawer. The selected context (organization, property, account, workspace, etc.) determines the scope of all data displayed throughout the app. Features a minimal select dropdown for quick context switching.

blocks.name: Basic Application Layout with Tabs
blocks.description: Standard application shell with a borderless page toolbar and tab bar navigation below it, featuring a top app bar with logo, title, icon action buttons, and user profile menu with theme toggle; a left navigation drawer with icon list items; a responsive auto-fitting grid content area; and a footer toolbar with centered text

blocks.name: Basic Application Layout
blocks.description: Standard application shell featuring a top app bar with logo, title, icon action buttons, and user profile menu with theme toggle; a left navigation drawer with icon list items; a responsive auto-fitting grid content area; and a footer toolbar with centered text
